scope: Read-only HML database and one Sandbox GET payment

sources.mainAttendanceDocument: Absent at this revision; current homologation documentation retained

executionAssessment.reason: The route runs inbox, reconciliation, expiration and outbox. Inbox claim only supports batch limit, not an explicit event ID.
requiredPreparation: Use a reviewed and tested mechanism that claims exactly the target event, validates homologation account/order identity and preserves the existing worker lease/fencing and evidence logic.
Refresh read-only provider state and scoped backup before any mutation; abort if the identity, value or current state differs from this preparation.
Process only that inbox event; do not call general reconciliation, expiration, outbox dispatch or provider mutation commands.
Compare before/after order, stock, reservations, financial facts and order 3 review. Repeat-event acceptance must not create financial or stock effects.
expectedIfProviderStillOverdue: Persist remote OVERDUE charge evidence and complete the inbox event using the existing worker.
Do not mark order PAID, create payment-confirmation email, refund, cancel remotely, or release stock solely from overdue notification.
Any reservation expiry correction/release requires separate review of the stored boleto policy.
